services.name: Meade County EMS
services.evidence: "KSP was assisted at the scene by Meade County Sheriff's Office, Meade County EMS, Muldraugh Fire Department, Flaherty Fire Department, ..."
services.licence_evidence: KBEMS EMS Directory 2026-08-01, licence 1091, Class Ia: "911 Response (Scene) with Transport Capability"; service area "Meade County"

21163.page_note: Meade County EMS carries 911 patients in Meade County and is the only 911 ambulance licence in the county. Fort Knox has its own on-post ambulance transport.

services.name: Deaconess EMS
services.evidence: "If you or a loved one experience a medical emergency, call 9-1-1. Skilled medical professionals will provide crucial pre-hospital care during transport to the most appropriate Deaconess facility. ... Our Kentucky/ Indiana teams serve Henderson & Union County"
services.licence_evidence: KBEMS EMS Directory 2026-08-01, licence 1043, Class Ia: "911 Response (Scene) with Transport Capability"; service area "Henderson & Union County"

21101.page_note: Deaconess EMS carries 911 patients in all of Henderson County, including the city of Henderson. It is the only 911 ambulance licence in the county; Henderson Fire Department does not run ambulances.
21101.second_source: Kentucky NG911 EMS boundary layer still labels the area 'AMR-Henderson' (older operator name); no AMR licence exists for Henderson County in the 2026-08-01 state list

services.name: AmeriPro EMS of Kentucky (licence 1707)
services.area: unconfirmed in Oldham (contract found is Henry County)
services.evidence: "Henry County Ambulance Taxing District officials last Monday got an earful about its decision to ditch service with Baptist Health and sign a contract with AmeriPro."

21185.page_note: Oldham County EMS, run by Baptist Health for the county ambulance taxing district, provides 911 ambulance service to Oldham County. AmeriPro EMS is also licensed for Oldham County; its confirmed 911 contract is in neighbouring Henry County, and whether it carries 911 patients in Oldham County is not yet confirmed.

21029.page_note: Bullitt County EMS carries 911 patients across Bullitt County. Mt. Washington Fire & EMS is licensed for 911 ambulance service in the Mt. Washington fire district (it added an EMS unit in 2021); a current page confirming it transports patients is not yet found. Zoneton Fire has proposed, but not started, its own ambulances.
